story.姓名學的流派很多，筆畫算法和 81 數理表都有不同版本。這裡用康熙筆畫；兩種數理: How it works: name analysis (姓名學) counts the strokes of each character as the Kangxi Dictionary (康熙字典) writes it, where a radical counts as the full character it stands for. The counts add up to five numbers, the Five Grids (五格): Heaven (the surname), Person (the last character of the surname with the first of the given name, the main one), Earth (the given name), Outer, and Total (every stroke). A one-character surname or given name borrows an extra 1 (假一) to make the sum. Each number is then read against a traditional table of 81 meanings. Schools differ in how they count strokes and in their tables; a number on which the two tables used here disagree counts as half favourable.
story.五格、三才、三運的解說都是傳統說法，僅供參考。名字在這個模擬裡的影響很小，每個領: The readings of the Five Grids, the Three Talents and the three lucks are traditional sayings, for reference only. A name’s effect in this simulation is very small, at most ±5% in each area of life, and it never touches lifespan or serious illness.

story.萬物開泰的起頭數。天地初開、一元復始，凡事從無到有皆由此始。此數之人心志獨立、主: The number of beginnings, when everything first opens up: heaven and earth part, and all things start from nothing. People with this number are independent and strong-minded, unwilling to work under others, and would rather open their own path than carry on an old one. Early on they mostly rise by their own efforts; after middle age the foundations firm up, and fame and fortune come together. Too much independence borders on aloofness, though, and doing everything yourself wears out body and mind; if you can make room for others and hand over some of the work, the good fortune can last.
story.混沌未分的分離數。陰陽未定、進退失據，此數之人心思細而志不堅，起念多而落實少，常: The number of separation, before chaos has settled. Yin and yang are not yet fixed, and it is hard to know whether to go forward or back. People with this number think finely but lack resolve: many ideas, few carried through, often torn between two choices and tempted to give up halfway. Even with real ability it is hard to put all their strength in one place, so life brings many twists and fewer achievements, and family ties can scatter. Choosing one thing and seeing it through, and listening less to others, can still win back a good part.
story.陰陽調和的進取數。天地人三才俱備，智達明敏、才藝兼具，此數之人少年即顯穎悟，善解: A number of progress, with yin and yang in harmony. Heaven, earth and humankind are all in place: bright, quick and gifted. People with this number show their talent young, understand others well and are well liked, and elders are glad to help them, so chances come early; in middle age fame and fortune both arrive, and later years are settled. Cleverness worn on the sleeve invites envy, though; modesty keeps the good fortune for long.
story.破滅衰敗的凶數。諸事不順、萬事難成，此數之人縱有才智亦難得施展之地，謀事每於將成: A challenging number of decline. Things go against you and little comes easily: people with this number may be able and clever yet find little room to use it, and plans tend to fall through just as they near success. Health may be frail and family ties thin, with upheavals early in life. Turning it round is possible, but it takes great willpower and hard work; keep what you have rather than gamble, and focus on one thing rather than many, to stay clear of the worst.
story.陰陽交感的完璧數。五行俱全、剛柔並濟，此數之人性溫和而有主張，處事圓融不失分寸，: A number of perfect balance, where yin and yang meet. All five elements are present, firmness and gentleness together. People with this number are mild yet have their own views, and handle things smoothly without losing their sense of proportion, so they get on with everyone and find doors open on every side. Blessings come of themselves, the family thrives and life is long: one of the most complete favourable numbers. When everything goes well it is easy to grow lazy; stay diligent and upright, and life holds no regrets.
story.安穩餘慶的吉數。天德地祥兼備，此數之人多生於有根基之家，或早年得貴人之蔭，故立業: A favourable number of stability and blessings that last. Heaven’s favour and earth’s good fortune are both here. People with this number are often born into a family with a solid base, or helped by someone influential early on, so building a career is not hard; warm and tolerant, they see the family prosper and their good fortune run long, especially in later years. Long ease can sap ambition, though: keep a little drive in comfortable times, or what holds for a while may not hold for life.
story.剛毅果斷的獨立數。意志剛強、精力充沛，此數之人認定一事便能排除萬難以赴，故常於逆: An independent number of firmness and decision. Strong-willed and full of energy, people with this number, once set on something, will push through every obstacle to get it, and often show their best in hard times; many succeed by middle age. But they can be rigid and slow to bend, too blunt with others, which breeds friction. Cultivating gentleness and listening to other views lets that firmness hold without breaking, and the achievements grow larger.
story.有志竟成: where there’s a will, there’s a way
story.意志剛健的進取數。有堅忍不拔之志，能耐勞苦而貫徹始終，此數之人不以聰明取勝，而以: A number of steady progress and a firm will. People with this number have unshakeable resolve and can bear hardship and see things through. They win not by cleverness but by persistence, so success comes late but sure; things improve after middle age, and later years are especially good. What is too hard can snap, though: leave room to manoeuvre, and do not wear yourself out meeting force with force.
story.興盡凶始的破舟數。才謀雖足而時運不濟，此數之人每有大志、亦具能力，然謀事常功敗垂: The number of the broken boat, where good fortune runs out and trouble begins. Talent and plans are there but the times are not: people with this number often have big ambitions and the ability to match, yet plans fail at the last moment, or succeed and then fall apart, like a broken boat putting out to sea, where the harder you row the closer the danger. Family ties can be thin and health poor, especially around middle age. Keep to your own work and team up with someone strong; standing alone is where the risk lies.
story.萬事終局的空虛數。天賦雖厚而運途多蹇，此數之人常懷壯志卻屢遇障阻，謀事至半而基垮: The number of emptiness, where everything comes to an end. Gifts are plenty but the road is rough: people with this number often have big dreams yet keep meeting obstacles, plans collapse halfway, and a life of hard work brings less than it deserves; the family, too, sees many partings. Success is not ruled out, but it calls for extra care and gratitude for what you have, and good numbers in the other grids can soften it.
story.挽回家運的春成數。草木逢春、枝葉更新，此數之人性穩而有再興之力，縱出身寒微或家道: The number of spring, which restores a family’s fortunes. Like plants in spring putting out new leaves, people with this number are steady and able to rise again: even from humble beginnings, or a family in decline, careful work lets them rebuild. Money comes gradually rather than suddenly, a picture of growing rich through steadiness. Later years are especially rich, and the children share the blessings.
story.意志薄弱的挫折數。家親緣薄、孤立無援，此數之人常以柔弱之力擔過重之事，力不從心而: A number of setbacks and a weak will. Family ties are thin and help is scarce. People with this number often take on loads too heavy for their strength and force themselves on, so they stumble halfway; once their resolve wavers, earlier work is lost, and overwork can harm their health. Know your limits and accept help from outside; do not insist on carrying everything alone.
story.智略超群的博學數。天賦藝能、多才多藝，此數之人機敏善斷，臨事能於紛亂中理出頭緒，: A number of learning and outstanding strategy. Gifted in many arts, people with this number are sharp and decisive and can find order in chaos, so others often rely on them; writing, strategy and eloquence all shine, and they make their name by middle age. Great talent tends towards conceit, though: balance it with honesty and kindness, and envy will stay away.
story.破兆離散的沉淪數。家庭緣薄、孤獨悲哀，此數之人多情而少得回應，用心而少見回報，故: A number of breaking and drifting apart. Family ties are thin, with loneliness and sorrow. People with this number give much love and get little back, put in much care and see little return, so their hearts are often heavy; work, too, can turn suddenly even in good times, like a boat striking a hidden reef. Build something solid early, make many good friends, and do not let loneliness and resentment pile up inside.
story.福壽圓滿的最大吉數。溫和恭謙、雅量厚德，此數之人以德服人而非以力壓人，故上下和順: The greatest favourable number, of blessings and long life. Gentle, modest and generous, people with this number win others by kindness rather than force, so everyone around them gets on; family, work, fame, fortune, blessings and long life are all complete, one of the fullest of the 81 numbers. Those with it should keep their generous character: while the virtue lasts, so does the good fortune.
story.厚重載德的興家數。能得眾望、成就大業，此數之人度量寬宏，善納人言，故人才樂為所用: A number that carries virtue and builds a family, winning many people’s trust and great achievements. Broad-minded and willing to listen, people with this number attract able people who are glad to work with them, so even from small beginnings they grow into something great; after middle age wealth and position both arrive, and the family flourishes. Generosity can slide into leniency, though: even with people you trust, keep some measure.
story.剛強突破的權威數。意志堅定、突破萬難，此數之人一往無前，遇阻不退，故常能開出別人: A number of authority and breaking through. Resolute and able to overcome great difficulty, people with this number press forward and do not retreat in the face of obstacles, so they often open doors others cannot. Stubbornness and refusing advice are this number’s weakness, and pride can cause friction with others. Be firm inside a gentle manner and listen to unwelcome advice, and the authority will last.
story.有志竟成的鐵石數。志向堅固、意志如鐵，此數之人一旦立志便不輕改，能於長期困頓中守: A number of iron will that gets there in the end. Once people with this number set a goal they rarely change it, and can keep their direction through long hard spells, so authority and success come at last; money follows, and later years are especially good. Strong pride and a dislike of being crossed can lead to head-on clashes, though; cultivate a more accepting heart.
story.風雲蔽月的破滅數。智謀雖足而遭遇不遇，此數之人常有超群之才，亦每有驚人之舉，然時: A number of ruin, like clouds blown across the moon. Wise and capable but out of luck, people with this number often have exceptional talent and do remarkable things, yet the times work against them, and success and failure come and go like clouds over the moon, now bright, now dark; illness and injury in the family also need watching. Go steadily rather than hurry, hold rather than attack, and lean on good numbers in the other grids.
story.非業破運的空虛數。萬事不成、災難重重，此數之人一生多逢挫折與不測，謀事屢起屢躓，: A number of emptiness and broken luck. Little works out and misfortunes pile up: people with this number meet many setbacks and surprises, plans rise and fall again and again, and body and mind grow tired; illness and money losses also show here. It is not hopeless, but it calls for keeping what you have very carefully; avoid gambles and rash moves, and you can keep yourself and your family safe.
story.明月中天的獨立權威數。光風霽月、萬象昭然，此數之人具首領之資，性情明朗而有決斷，: A number of independence and authority, like a bright moon high in the sky. Clear skies, a light breeze and everything plain to see: people with this number have the makings of a leader, open by nature and decisive, so they can set up on their own and rise step by step, enjoying fame, fortune and the respect of many. Strong opinions can lead to quarrels; temper firmness with gentleness.
story.秋草逢霜的薄弱數。志向雖高而力不能副，此數之人內心敏感、外表未必示人，遇挫則傷，: A frail number, like autumn grass touched by frost. Ambitions run higher than strength. People with this number are sensitive inside, though they may not show it, and are hurt by setbacks, so they often want to give up halfway; frail health and thin family ties are common. Choose steady work and dependable friends, and do not take on great tasks alone.
story.旭日東昇的隆昌數。壯麗壯觀、旭日東昇，此數之人氣魄宏大，雖出身微賤亦能憑一己之力: A number of prosperity, like the sun rising in the east. Grand and full of vigour, people with this number think big: even from humble beginnings they can rise high by their own efforts and hold real power by middle age, a leader’s number. Wealth and position are both strong, and later years are glorious. At the peak, beware of pride, and rein yourself in when too forceful.
story.家門餘慶的金錢數。財源廣進、白手成家，此數之人智謀出眾而擅理財，能於無中生有、由: A number of money and a family’s lasting blessings. Money flows in and a family is built from nothing. People with this number are clever and good with money, able to make something out of nothing and grow small into large, so even from modest beginnings they can build great wealth; later years are especially rich, and the blessings reach the children. Keep your hard-working, thrifty ways, and do not turn extravagant once rich.
story.英俊剛毅的資性聰敏數。賢性銳敏、才氣奇特，此數之人多具異於常人的見識與手腕，能獲: A number of quick intelligence, handsome and resolute. Sharp-minded and unusually gifted, people with this number often have insight and skill beyond the ordinary and can achieve great things. But they can be one-sided, with a sharp, sarcastic tongue or odd, impatient habits, and without self-discipline they fall out with people and cause harm. With patience and modesty, they can succeed.
story.變怪奇異的英雄數。波瀾重疊、萬難襲來，此數之人多具英雄氣概與非常才智，然一生起伏: A heroic number of strange, unusual change. Wave after wave and every kind of difficulty: people with this number often have a hero’s spirit and uncommon intelligence, but life swings widely, great success or great failure, and is rarely smooth; loneliness, injury and bankruptcy also appear. Extraordinary people walk extraordinary roads: keep your heart steady and choose the right path, and after the storms there is much to show.
story.慾望無止的中折數。才略過人而易招誹謗，此數之人早熟而發育良好，壯年或中年即得早發: A number of endless desire that breaks off midway. Talent beyond others, but it draws criticism. People with this number mature early and may succeed young or in their prime; but a strong ego that will not bow invites attack and blame, so careers break off midway and are hard to revive later. If you can look at yourself, soften your edge and treat others sincerely, you can still avoid failure and find wealth and honour.
story.闊水浮萍的遭難數。雖有豪傑之氣魄，卻如浮萍無根，一生波瀾不斷，起伏難安。此數之人: A number of misfortune, like duckweed on wide water. A hero’s spirit, but rootless as floating duckweed, with wave after wave and little peace. People with this number often meet setbacks midway; family ties are thin, couples can part, and injury or illness may worry them; even a success is hard to keep for long. There is a way out: choose one place and put down roots, moving and changing less, to soften it.
story.智謀優秀的財力成大業數。智謀兼具、財力豐厚，此數之人有奇才亦有手腕，能於紛亂中理: A number of fine strategy, wealth and great undertakings. Clever and well resourced, people with this number have unusual talent and skill, can find opportunities in chaos, and build something big by middle age, with fame, fortune and a good name. But desire grows too, and greed brings blame; beware of being too forceful as well, and be content with enough.
story.吉凶難分: good and bad hard to tell apart
story.宜守正道: best to keep to the right path
story.非運非命的浮沉數。吉凶難分之數，此數之人一生成敗皆極端：得意時如日中天，失意時一: A number of rise and fall, where good and bad are hard to tell apart. People with this number meet extremes: in good times they are at their height, in bad times they fall hard, all depending on the road they take. Speculation and gambling on luck invite trouble most; keep to the right path and do real, solid work, and after the ups and downs there is still much to show. Of the 81 numbers, this one depends most on the person’s own choices.
story.春日花開的智勇得志數。智仁勇三者兼備，此數之人性溫和而有統率之才，能得眾望而不失: A number of wisdom and courage that reach their goal, like flowers opening in spring. Wise, kind and brave, people with this number are gentle yet able to lead, win many people’s trust without overstepping, and so succeed without having to fight for it; after middle age their reputation grows, and both work and family prosper. A favourable number for everyone.
story.寶馬金鞍: A Fine Horse with a Golden Saddle
story.僥倖多望的意外惠澤數。多得貴人提拔，往往在意外中獲得成功，如寶馬配金鞍，是承他人: A number of luck and unexpected favour. Often helped by influential people, people with this number tend to succeed by surprise, like a fine horse with a golden saddle: a favourable number that rises on others’ help. Chances come their way unusually often; but good fortune that comes from outside must be seized and treasured, and if you forget those who helped you, it goes as fast as it came.
story.旭日升天的鸞鳳相會數。旺盛至極之數，此數之人才德兼備、氣魄宏大，能成非常之大業，: A number of the rising sun, where the phoenixes meet: a number of the greatest vigour. People with this number have both talent and virtue and think big, can achieve extraordinary things, and see the family thrive and their name spread far. But extremes turn back: at the peak, beware of pride; too much force causes friction with others, so rein yourself in and temper it with gentleness.
story.破家的大凶數。災難重疊、破家之兆，此數之人縱有才具亦難敵其運，謀事屢遭中斷，或因: A very challenging number of a family in ruin. Misfortunes pile up, a sign of the family breaking: even able people with this number struggle against their luck, plans are cut off again and again, or one matter drags down the whole; illness, injury and a scattered family all appear here. Good numbers in the other grids can soften it, but on the whole it is best to keep what you have and know your place, and to avoid big moves.
story.宜文: suited to the arts and letters
story.溫良和順的智達之數。溫和平靜、智達通暢，此數之人不長於開疆拓土，而長於守成與文事: A number of gentle kindness and clear understanding. Calm, mild and clear-minded, people with this number are better at keeping and tending than at breaking new ground, and good at the arts and letters; art, writing and skilled work all bring results, and family life is mostly harmonious. Forcing themselves to lead, or to hold up a whole enterprise, tends to go wrong; settle into your strengths and a smooth life can be expected.
story.波瀾重疊的俠義之數。俠義心腸、捨己為人，此數之人重情重義，常為他人奔走而不計得失: A number of chivalry and wave upon wave. Big-hearted and selfless, people with this number value loyalty and friendship, often run about for others without counting the cost, and are much liked; but their own fortunes rise and fall and are rarely settled, and they often help others succeed at their own expense. Keep a little of that generosity for yourself, so the effort is not in vain.
story.權威顯達、吉人天相數。天稟溫和忠實，獨行而有權威，大德奏功之象。此數之人不以巧取: A number of authority and distinction, where heaven looks after good people. Gentle and loyal by nature, independent and with authority of their own: a picture of great virtue rewarded. People with this number win not by cleverness but by honesty and character, so their work gains step by step, and in the end they build something great and enjoy wealth and honour. Going it alone is also their weakness: carrying everything themselves wears them out, and if they can make room for others and hand over some of the work, the good fortune can last.
story.磨鐵成針的意志薄弱數。統率之力不足，然若肯專一磨礪，亦能於一技一藝上成器。此數之: A number of a gentle will, like grinding an iron rod into a needle. Not strong at leading others, but with focused effort people with this number can master a craft or a skill. Do not compete hard or spread yourself thin; choose one craft or profession and go deep. Hard work brings modest success, haste brings failure: a number where what you hold on to is yours.
story.富貴榮華的變化無窮數。權威與財富俱盛，此數之人有雄才亦有雅量，能統眾而不失人心，: A number of wealth, glory and endless change. Authority and wealth are both strong: people with this number have great talent and a generous spirit, can lead many without losing their hearts, and enjoy wealth, long life and a thriving family, one of the very best of the 81 numbers. It holds the seed of great change, though, so at the peak beware of a turn; when too forceful, put more care into people and feelings.
story.退安則吉、進取則凶數。智謀雖足而德望不稱，此數之人常有膽識與手腕，然易生投機之心: A number that is good in retreat and bad in advance. Clever, but with less virtue and respect than talent, people with this number often have nerve and skill but are drawn to speculation, and once they rush ahead they fail. Hold back, go steadily, and be content to keep what you have; if you temper talent with virtue and take fewer shortcuts, you can stay safe; otherwise life rises and falls without settling.
story.德望高大的有德之數。膽識、德望、才藝俱備，此數之人處事有分寸而待人有誠意，故事業: A number of virtue and high respect. Courage, character and talent are all here: people with this number act with a sense of proportion and treat others sincerely, so their work flourishes and fame and fortune both come, purely favourable with nothing mixed in. Later years are especially good, and the blessings reach the children. Those with it should keep their generous character: while the virtue lasts, so does the good fortune.
story.寒蟬在柳: A Cicada in a Cold Willow
story.寒蟬在柳的博而不精數。多才多藝而失之於雜，此數之人涉獵極廣、樣樣能通，卻少有一門: A number of wide learning without depth, like a cicada in a willow in the cold. Many talents, but scattered: people with this number take an interest in everything and can turn their hand to anything, yet rarely take one thing all the way, so they often sigh that they know a bit of everything and nothing well. Choose one specialty early; breadth without depth seldom adds up to much.
story.散財破產的雨夜之花數。外表華美而內裡空虛，此數之人多有才藝與見識，然意志不堅、用: A number of scattered wealth, like a flower in the rain at night. Fine on the outside but hollow within: people with this number often have talent and insight, but a weak will and no limits on spending, so money comes easily and goes easily; family ties are thin and later years can be bleak. Self-discipline, careful spending and one solid line of work can still keep them from going under.
story.愁眉難展的破家數。諸事不順、災禍疊來，此數之人縱有奇才亦每逢逆運，謀事屢遭中斷；: A number of family ruin and worries that will not lift. Things go wrong and misfortunes come one after another: even with rare talent people with this number keep meeting bad luck, and plans are cut off again and again; a broken family, illness and injury also appear. A very few with exceptional will turn adversity into a new world, but for most it is better to hold rather than attack, and to stay still rather than move.
story.順風揚帆的新生之數。智謀周備、經緯深奧，此數之人思慮縝密而識見深遠，能於大局中看: A number of new life, sailing before a fair wind. Thorough and deep in their thinking, people with this number plan carefully and see far, can see the pattern in the big picture, and so their plans mostly go well; after middle age great ambitions are realised and glory can be expected. Guard against pride and impatience, and life will meet few headwinds.
story.能自立可轉: standing on your own turns it round
story.羅網繫身的離祖成家數。一生困苦不離身之凶數，此數之人意志若薄，易走入歧途而受縲紲: A number of being caught in a net, and of leaving home to build a family. A challenging number of lifelong hardship: if their will is weak, people with this number can stray onto the wrong road and suffer for it, working hard all their lives with much sorrow. But with a will of their own, and kindness and principle to hold on to, they can leave their roots behind, build their own family and turn hardship into something new. A number that depends entirely on willpower.
story.點石成金的開花結果數。天賦幸運、貴人自來，此數之人做事往往順水推舟即成，家門隆昌: A number of flowers that bear fruit, like turning stone into gold. Born lucky, with helpers who come of themselves, people with this number often succeed just by going with the flow; the family and the children thrive, and money is plentiful, a rare number of deep blessings. Later years are especially good; those with it should do good for others, and the blessings will last.
story.古松立鶴: A Crane on an Old Pine
story.古松立鶴的德智兼備數。德望與智謀俱高，此數之人可為人師、可為人謀，處事有分寸而言: A number of virtue and wisdom together, like a crane standing on an old pine. Both respected and wise, people with this number can teach and advise others, act with a sense of proportion and speak with weight, so they are respected without making enemies; fame and fortune may not be at their peak, but they last and stay steady. The number best suited to the road of expertise and reputation.
story.吉凶難分的轉變之數。此數含大轉折之機，遇吉則大吉、遇凶則大凶，全看他格配合與自身: A number of change, where good and bad are hard to tell apart. It holds the seed of a great turning point: with good company it is very good, with bad company very bad, depending on the other grids and on your own choices. People with this number meet many crossroads in life: one right step and everything comes alive, one wrong step and everything is lost.
story.小舟入海: A Small Boat Out to Sea
story.小舟入海的一成一敗數。盛衰交替之數，此數之人常有一次大成，亦常有一次大敗，先成後: A number of one success and one failure, like a small boat putting out to sea. Rise and fall take turns: people with this number often have one great success and one great failure, most often success first; middle age is the turning point. Keep a way out when things go well, and hold your ground when they do not; in later years especially, guard against a collapse, and contentment keeps you safe.
story.宜守成: best to keep what you have
story.盛衰交加的沉浮之數。先盛後衰之象，此數之人早年多順、名利來得不難，然中年後漸見榮: A number of rising and falling in turn: first flourishing, then declining. Early life mostly goes well for people with this number, with fame and fortune coming easily, but after middle age fortunes come and go, and without planning ahead later years can be lonely. Keep rather than expand, save rather than spend: holding on to the gains of the first half of life is the wise course.
story.先見之明的理想實現數。有先見之明、精幹之才，此數之人意志堅定而善於謀劃，能察時世: A number of foresight and ideals realised. Far-sighted and highly capable, people with this number are determined and good at planning, read the times and seize opportunities, so they often make their move before anyone else has noticed; what others find hard often comes easily in their hands, and in the end they win both fame and fortune.
story.曲捲難伸: Curled Up and Unable to Stretch
story.外祥內患的盛衰參半數。外觀華美而內裡多憂，此數之人表面看去順遂，實則內有難言之患: A number of half rise, half fall: calm outside, troubled inside. Fine to look at but full of worries within, people with this number seem to have an easy life but carry troubles they cannot speak of; those whose first half goes well often find the second hard, and those whose first half is hard often find the second at peace. Learn early what is real and what is show, and turn outward appearances into solid footing, so as not to waste yourself.
story.石上栽花的多難數。憂悶困苦、辛苦難成，此數之人縱極盡努力亦每見徒勞，如石上栽花難: A number of many troubles, like planting flowers on stone. Gloomy and hard: even with their very best efforts, people with this number often see little come of it, like flowers that cannot root on stone; family ties are thin and health poor, and later years need care. Strong good numbers in the other grids can soften it, but on the whole it is best to know your place, accept your lot and not force things.
story.善惡交集的極盛還衰數。外觀極美而內裡極苦，此數之人常被人羨而自知其難；表面的順遂: A number of good and bad together, where the peak turns to decline. Beautiful on the outside but bitter within: people with this number are envied by others while knowing their own difficulties; real hardship hides beneath the smooth surface, and things often turn sharply down at their very peak. The answer is endurance: bear what others will not bear and keep to what others will not keep, and beyond the fine outside you will have something solid inside.
story.浪裡行舟的事與願違數。缺乏實行之力，此數之人多有想法而少有落實，事至臨門每見遲疑: A number of things going against your wishes, like sailing through waves. Short on follow-through, people with this number have many ideas but carry few out, and hesitate at the last step, so their wishes are seldom met; later years can be especially hard. If they add the missing step of finishing what they start, and plan less and do more, they can still win back a good deal; otherwise it stays work on paper.
story.寒雪青松: a green pine in the snow
story.日照春松的寒雪青松數。雖有一時之大難，然天賦幸運，此數之人如寒雪中的青松，越是逆: A number of the green pine in winter snow, lit by the spring sun. There may be one great hardship, but they are born lucky: like a green pine in the snow, people with this number show their quality most in adversity. Around middle age comes one big hurdle; get past it and the rest of life opens up, sweetness after bitterness, with glory to enjoy. A number where those who endure win.
story.晚行遇月: Meeting the Moon on a Late Walk
story.晚行遇月的先苦後甘數。浮沉多端，此數之人前半生辛苦、屢遭挫折，家業亦有一度傾頹；: A number of bitterness first and sweetness later, like meeting the moon on a late walk. Many ups and downs: the first half of life is hard for people with this number, with repeated setbacks, and the family business may decline for a while; but after middle age things get better and better, and later years are peaceful and comfortable. No need to rush: treat the first half as building up, and the second half will reward you.
story.寒蟬悲風: A Cicada in the Autumn Wind
story.寒蟬悲風的寸進難伸數。缺乏勇氣與耐力，此數之人一遇挫折即生退意，故雖有機會亦每每: A number of little progress, like a cold cicada in a sad wind. Short on courage and stamina, people with this number want to give up at the first setback, so they often miss the chances they have; money is hard to gather and a family business hard to build, and later years bring disappointment. The turn comes if you hold on in one place to the end and make trying once more a habit.
story.黑暗無光的動搖不定數。無謀無策、方針不定，此數之人常在幾條路之間反覆，做一半又改: A number of wavering, dark and without light. With no plan and no fixed course, people with this number keep going back and forth between paths, changing halfway, so a busy life achieves little; they are also prone to trouble with the law, illness and money losses. What matters most is not choosing right, but sticking with your choice once it is made.
story.牡丹芙蓉的名利雙收數。名利雙收、繁榮富貴，此數之人才華與機遇俱備，事業順遂而家門: A number of fame and fortune, like the peony and the lotus. Fame, fortune, prosperity and standing: people with this number have both talent and opportunity, their work goes well and the family thrives. It holds a seed of arrogance, though: success makes it easy to get carried away, and good times make it easy to look down on others; without self-control, discord grows inside and they become their own undoing.
story.基礎虛弱的內外不和數。根基不固、內外失和，此數之人外面看去尚可，內裡卻經不起考驗: A number of weak foundations and discord inside and out. The base is not firm and harmony is lacking: people with this number look fine from outside but cannot stand a real test, and crumble at the first storm, losing others’ trust along the way. Mend the roots first and make peace with people first; build a solid foundation before talking about growth.
story.萬物化育的富貴榮華數。萬物化育、諸事順遂，此數之人身心健全、家庭圓滿，事業穩步而: A number of wealth and glory, where all things grow. Everything flourishes and goes smoothly: people with this number are healthy in body and mind, their family is complete, their work advances steadily with few headwinds, and their children thrive; a purely favourable number. Those with it meet few great storms; keep the peace, and there is no need to fight.
story.骨肉分離的沉滯破敗數。災禍頻仍、骨肉分離，此數之人縱勤勉亦難敵其運，謀事屢遭破敗: A number of stagnation and decline, with kin parted. Frequent misfortune and family separations: even hard-working people with this number struggle against their luck, plans fail again and again, and family ties are especially thin; illness and money losses also appear. Know your place, take few risks, and lean on good numbers in the other grids.
story.巨流歸海: A Great River Reaching the Sea
story.巨流歸海的家運隆昌數。事事如意、家運隆昌，此數之人如江河歸海，行事自有其歸處，故: A number of thriving family fortunes, like a great river reaching the sea. Everything goes as you wish and the family prospers: like a river flowing to the sea, people with this number find their way naturally, so they enjoy wealth and long life with few hardships; everyone gets on, and later years are especially rich. One of the steadiest favourable numbers of the 81.
story.岩頭步馬: A Horse on a Cliff Top
story.岩頭步馬的內外不和數。進退失據、內外不和，此數之人如在岩頭驅馬，前無路而後無援，: A number of discord inside and out, like riding a horse along a cliff top. With no footing forward or back, people with this number are like riders on a cliff edge, no road ahead and no help behind, and plans lose their footing at the key moment; misfortunes and losses are many. Cut back sharply, keep to what you know, and do not fight on many fronts at once.
story.通達順遂的自立成業數。事事通達、得長輩提攜，此數之人有獨立開創之力，亦能得外助，: A number of things going smoothly and of building your own business. Everything gets through and elders lend a hand: people with this number can strike out on their own and also win outside help, so the family business grows and their name rises; money is plentiful, and later years especially good. Those with it should seize their chances and not stop for comfort.
story.興家立業: building a family and a career
story.順風揚帆的興家立業數。思慮周密、勤勉務實，此數之人不靠投機而靠積累，故所成雖不迅: A number of building a family and a career, sailing before the wind. Careful, hard-working and practical, people with this number rely not on speculation but on steady building, so what they achieve comes slowly but very surely; starting a business, inventing and managing all go well, and they can both build a family business and keep it. One of the numbers best suited to the long game.
story.非業非命的動搖不安數。窮迫困頓、動搖不安，此數之人常處於「明知不對卻停不下來」的: A number of unrest. Hard pressed and unsettled, people with this number often find themselves unable to stop something they know is wrong; plans stumble again and again, body and mind grow weary, and health is a real worry. Cut losses early and step back early: better to do less than to force it.
story.慘淡空虛的險惡之數。空虛慘淡之象，此數之人一生多逢廢亡與損耗，縱有一時之得亦難留: A dangerous number of bleakness and emptiness. A bleak, empty picture: people with this number meet many losses and endings, and even what they gain for a time is hard to keep; later years can be especially lonely. Keeping what you have very carefully, and planning early for old age, can soften the worst.
story.石上金花的內心勞苦數。外觀尚可而內心多苦，此數之人有相當的能力，然缺一股貫徹到底: A number of inner toil, like golden flowers on stone. Fine to look at, hard inside: people with this number have real ability but lack the drive to see things through, so they often stop halfway; with an influential helper, or by joining forces with others, they can succeed. A number where you struggle alone but succeed together.
story.先甘後苦的勞苦之數。苦樂參半，此數之人前半生多順、看似福厚，然中年後漸入辛勞，晚: A number of toil, sweet first and bitter later. Half joy and half sorrow: the first half of life mostly goes well for people with this number and looks blessed, but after middle age it becomes harder work, and many find later years difficult. In good times keep a way out, spend carefully and save, and set aside the extra from the good days for the hard stretch ahead.
story.志高力微的天賦平安數。志向高遠而實行之力不足，此數之人常有超出能力的抱負，故大業: A number of high ambition, little strength and a peaceful lot. Ambitions run far ahead of the power to carry them out, so people with this number often aim beyond their reach, and great undertakings rarely come off; but they are blessed with peace, with enough to eat and wear and a harmonious family, and though life brings no great success it brings no great disaster either. To be content with this is itself a blessing.
story.坐食山空: living off savings until they run out
story.殘菊逢霜的沉淪之數。無為坐食、智謀不足，此數之人既少開創之力亦少守成之心，家業漸: A number of sinking, like withered chrysanthemums in frost. Idle and short of ideas, people with this number have little drive to build and little care to keep, so the family’s wealth slowly runs down with nothing to replace it; later years are especially hard. Making up for weaknesses with hard work, and learning a trade early, can still keep them going.
story.守分則吉: good when you keep your place
story.守分則吉、進取則凶數。此數之人守則安、動則敗：安分守成可保平順，一旦冒進、擴張、: A number that is good when you keep your place and bad when you push ahead. People with this number are safe when they stay put and fail when they move: keeping what they have brings a smooth life, but rushing ahead, expanding or speculating brings setbacks at once. Go steadily and work alongside someone strong rather than taking charge alone. Seeing this clearly is the best use of this number.
story.傾覆離散的內外不和數。傾覆離散之象，此數之人前半生多逢破敗與骨肉分離，家業與身心: A number of collapse, scattering and discord inside and out. In the first half of life people with this number often meet ruin and separation from their family, and both the family business and their health suffer; but if after middle age they find their resolve and start again, later years can turn peaceful. A number of breaking first and building after.
story.半吉半凶的苦樂參半數。前半生得享福澤者後半生多苦，前半生辛苦者後半生反安，此數之: A number of half good and half bad, half joy and half sorrow. Those who are blessed in the first half of life often struggle in the second, and those who struggle in the first are often at peace in the second; the turning point usually comes in middle age. Learn early to see the turn coming: in good times do not use up all your luck, and in bad times do not give up all your hopes.
story.禍福參半的晚苦之數。中年前尚見發達，才智亦足，然此數之人晚境多困，福澤有其盡頭。: A number of half misfortune and half blessing, with a hard old age. Before middle age things go well and talent is ample, but for people with this number later years are often difficult, and good fortune has its end. Save while you can and build while you can, and turn the strength of middle age into support for old age.
story.雲頭望月: Gazing at the Moon from the Clouds
story.雲頭望月的身疲力盡數。窮迫困頓、信用漸失，此數之人縱有才亦難施展，做事每見虎頭蛇: A number of exhaustion, like gazing at the moon from above the clouds. Hard pressed and losing trust, people with this number may be talented but find no room to use it, often starting strong and fizzling out, until others stop believing in them; money is hard to gather and body and mind grow tired. Rebuild trust first and do small, solid things first, and things can turn.
story.宜早退守靜: best to step back early and keep quiet
story.辛苦多難的遁吉之數。一生辛苦多難，此數之人若在世事中強爭，則處處碰壁；然若早退守: A number of hardship and trouble, with good fortune in retreat. A life of hard work and trouble: if people with this number fight hard in the world they hit walls everywhere; but if they step back early, keep quiet and settle for a simple life, they find a peaceful kind of good fortune. Of the 81 numbers, the one that says most plainly that stepping back beats pushing ahead.
story.萬物回春的還本歸元數。八十一為極數，還本歸元、復歸於一，故其吉與「1」同。此數之: A number of returning to the source, as spring returns to all things. Eighty-one is the last number: it goes back to the root and returns to one, so it is as favourable as 1. People with this number enjoy honour, prosperity, fame and fortune, a thriving family and long-lasting blessings: the full, happy close of the cycle of numbers.
story.上下同氣，一路順生，志向能伸、根基也穩，家門昌隆而身心康泰；唯同氣過盛易招妒，宜: Above and below share one energy and everything flows in order: ambitions can grow, the foundation is firm, the family thrives and body and mind are well. Too much of the same energy invites envy, though; stay modest.
story.上得其助、下有出口，事業無礙向上，境遇安泰，是少見的通達之局，晚景亦豐。: Help from above and an outlet below: work rises without hindrance and life is calm, a rare open road, with rich later years.
story.立木於厚土，雖為木剋土卻是天然之配，根基如磐石，能成事、能守成，名利可期。: A tree standing in deep soil: though Wood restrains Earth, it is a natural match. The foundation is solid as rock, able to achieve and to keep, with fame and fortune in prospect.
story.上下同氣而根基被金所制，縱肯苦幹亦伸展無力，境遇多變、屢受牽掣，心常鬱而事常折。: Above and below share one energy, but the foundation is held down by Metal: even with hard work there is no room to grow, life changes often and is often held back, the heart is often heavy and plans often broken.
story.上下相親、根得水潤，成功運尚可，唯水多則木浮，根基不實，安定難久，宜擇一處扎穩。: Above and below are close and the roots are watered, so success is fair; but too much Water makes Wood float, the foundation is not solid and stability is hard to keep. Best to put down roots in one place.
story.上下惠助、循環相生，志向順遂，地位與財帛俱安，子孫亦昌，是極穩的一局。: Help from above and below in a circle of support: ambitions go well, position and money are both secure, and the children thrive; a very steady arrangement.
story.上助其銳、下亦同熱，進取順當而聲勢不小，唯火氣過旺易生急躁，宜留三分餘地。: Above sharpens your edge and below burns just as hot: progress goes well and makes a stir, but too much Fire breeds impatience; leave some room to spare.
story.木生火、火生土，三才一路順行，成功與根基俱得，境遇安泰而能久，是最完滿的格局之一: Wood feeds Fire and Fire feeds Earth: the Three Talents flow in order, success and foundation are both secured, and life is calm and lasting; one of the most complete arrangements.
story.上有所助而根基被剋，銳氣雖足卻落不到實處，屢起屢躓，須防急躁招禍。: Help from above, but the foundation is under attack: plenty of drive that never lands, rising and stumbling again and again; beware of impatience bringing trouble.
story.上下相激，水火不容，成功之途屢遭澆熄，境遇急變，災厄疊來，宜守拙藏鋒。: Above and below clash, Water and Fire at odds: the road to success is doused again and again, life changes suddenly and troubles pile up. Best to lie low and hide your edge.
story.上剋其身、下又相侵，兩頭受制，志難得伸而根基不安，縱勤勉亦多勞少得。: Restrained from above and encroached on from below, held back at both ends: ambitions cannot stretch and the foundation is unsettled, so even hard work brings much toil for little gain.
story.雖受上剋，得下之溫助，境遇可稍安，能憑自身沉穩換取一時之成，晚運較前運為佳。: Restrained from above, but warmed and helped from below: life can settle a little, steadiness can win success for a time, and later luck is better than early luck.
story.上有所壓而根基厚實，雖上進遲緩，勝在守得住，安分經營亦可小成，宜穩不宜躁。: Pressed from above but with a solid foundation: progress is slow, but what you have, you keep; steady, contented work can bring modest success. Steady, not hasty.
story.上剋其身，然土能生金，根基有出口，成事費力而終有所得，宜借外力不宜獨扛。: Restrained from above, but Earth feeds Metal, so the foundation has an outlet: success takes effort but brings something in the end. Best to take help rather than carry it all alone.
story.上下俱不相謀，受剋於上、散流於下，根基崩落之象，境遇動盪，須防大變。: Above and below go their own ways: restrained from above and draining away below, a picture of a crumbling foundation. Life is unsettled; watch out for big changes.
story.上下皆與己相扞，剛氣衝撞，志高而處處受阻，孤立難成，且易傷身。: Both above and below clash with you, hard forces colliding: high ambitions blocked at every turn, isolated and struggling to succeed, and prone to harm to health.
story.上被己剋、下又剋己，前後受敵，縱有才具亦難安其位，多成多敗而心力交瘁。: You restrain what is above and what is below restrains you, with enemies front and back: even with ability it is hard to settle, with many successes and many failures that wear out body and mind.
story.因肯努力尚可得相當之成，境遇亦能安定，然成功運劣、難再上層，精神多磨而志難大伸。: Hard work can still bring decent success and a stable life, but Success Luck is poor and it is hard to climb higher; much wear on the spirit, and ambitions held back.
story.過於堅剛而被人排斥，陷於不和與孤獨，身心過勞，除非意志極堅，否則難展其志。: Too hard and rigid, and pushed away by others: discord and loneliness, body and mind overworked; unless the will is very strong, ambitions are hard to realise.
story.雖勤奮而徒勞少得，常懷煩悶，終因身心過勞而一再失敗；縱有一時安定，為時不久。: Hard work for little gain, often weighed down by worry, failing again and again from overwork in the end; even a spell of stability does not last long.
story.上下相榮，水木相生，成功順遂而根基穩固，得長上之蔭、亦得晚輩之力，福澤綿長。: Above and below flourish together, Water and Wood feeding each other: success goes smoothly and the foundation is firm, with shelter from elders and help from the young; blessings that last.
story.上雖相生，下則相激，根基屢受衝動，成而復敗，宜守成不宜擴張。: Fed from above but clashing below: the foundation is shaken again and again, success followed by failure. Keep what you have rather than expand.
story.得上之潤而受下之堵，志向可伸卻落不到實處，境遇進退兩難，須防積鬱成疾。: Watered from above but blocked below: ambitions can stretch but never land, stuck between going forward and back; beware of worries turning into illness.
story.金水相生、水木相榮，一路托舉，成功與根基俱佳，人緣亦厚，是極順的一局。: Metal feeds Water and Water nourishes Wood, lifting you all the way: success and foundation are both good, and friends are many; a very smooth arrangement.
story.上下俱得滋養，境遇安泰，才思敏捷而外緣佳，唯水盛則漂，宜擇定一事守到底。: Nourished above and below: life is calm, the mind quick and connections good; but too much Water makes you drift, so choose one thing and see it through.
story.上下同氣而得上之生，志向舒展、根基穩固，成功順遂，家門昌隆。: Above and below share one energy and you are fed from above: ambitions unfold, the foundation is firm, success goes smoothly and the family thrives.
story.木火通明，上下相榮，才思與聲名俱顯，進取順當，是極通達的一局。: Wood and Fire shining together, above and below flourishing: talent and reputation both shine and progress goes well; a very open road.
story.上生其身、下有厚土可立，成功與安定兼得，能開局亦能守成，福祿可期。: Fed from above, with deep soil to stand on below: success and stability together, able to start things and to keep them, with blessings in prospect.

story.三火相聚，聲勢極盛而根基易虛，成敗都來得快，宜以穩濟之，勿一味求快。: Three Fires together: great momentum but a hollow foundation, with success and failure both coming fast. Temper it with steadiness and do not chase speed alone.
story.火盛而能落成實土，熱情有著落，成功與根基兼得，名利可望長保。: Strong Fire that settles into solid Earth: the passion has somewhere to land, success and foundation come together, and fame and fortune can last.
story.上下同熱而根基被熔，銳氣雖盛卻守不住，屢成屢敗，且易傷身，宜大幅收斂。: Hot above and below, and the foundation melts: plenty of drive but nothing kept, success and failure in turn, and risk to health. Best to rein in hard.

story.下火生土、土又生上金，一路順行，根基厚實而助力不斷，名利可期。: Fire below feeds Earth and Earth feeds the Metal above, flowing in order: a deep foundation and help that never stops; fame and fortune in prospect.
story.上下皆厚，己身篤實，根基如磐，能成事亦能久守，晚景尤安。: Deep above and below and solid in yourself: a foundation like rock, able to achieve and to keep, with especially peaceful later years.
story.上下皆金而己土能生之，助力充沛，所積能守，境遇安固而少傾覆。: Metal above and below, fed by your Earth: plenty of help, savings kept, and a secure life with few collapses.
story.上得己生而下有流散，助力雖在、根基卻漏，成事之後須防守不住。: You feed what is above but drain away below: help is there but the foundation leaks, and after success it may not hold.
story.上下皆剛而根基被扞，過剛易折，與人多不合，縱能成事亦傷和氣而多孤。: Hard above and below, and the foundation under attack: what is too hard snaps easily; at odds with people, even success costs goodwill and brings loneliness.
story.上下同剛而下火來熔，銳氣受挫，屢成屢敗，宜收斂鋒芒、勿爭一時。: Equally hard above and below, and Fire below melts you: your drive is checked, with success and failure in turn. Hide your edge and do not fight for the moment.
story.厚土生金，上下皆得其助，根基穩、助力足，志向順遂而所積能守。: Deep Earth feeds Metal, with help above and below: a firm foundation and ample help; ambitions go well and savings are kept.
story.三金相聚，堅剛無比，能排萬難而成事；唯乏同化之力，孤高易生，宜養柔和。: Three Metals together, hard beyond compare: able to clear every obstacle and succeed; but slow to blend in, aloof and lonely, so cultivate gentleness.
story.上下同氣而氣能外達，才思敏捷、外緣尚可，唯金水寒涼，宜防內心空虛。: One energy above and below, reaching outward: quick-minded, with fair connections; but Metal and Water run cold, so guard against emptiness inside.
story.金生水、水生木，一路順行，得上之助而下有出口，成功順遂、根基亦穩。: Metal feeds Water and Water feeds Wood, flowing in order: helped from above with an outlet below, success goes smoothly and the foundation is firm.
story.上得其生而下來相激，根基屢受衝動，成而復敗，宜守成勿擴張。: Fed from above but clashing below: the foundation is shaken again and again, success followed by failure. Keep what you have and do not expand.
story.上生其身而下有所堵，志可伸而落地受阻，宜迂迴圖之、勿硬頂。: Fed from above but blocked below: ambitions can stretch but meet obstacles when they land. Go the long way round rather than push head-on.
story.前後皆金相生，助力充沛，才思敏捷而人緣佳，境遇安泰，是極順的一局。: Metal before and behind, both feeding you: ample help, a quick mind, many friends and a calm life; a very smooth arrangement.
story.上生而下同流，氣盛而根浮，一時可發大勢，宜及早扎穩而非四處遊走。: Fed from above and flowing together below: strong energy but floating roots, a great surge for a while. Best to put down roots early rather than wander.
story.水生木、上下同氣，一路托舉，志向舒展而根基穩固，得長上之蔭，家門昌隆。: Water feeds Wood, and above and below share one energy, lifting you all the way: ambitions unfold and the foundation is firm, with shelter from elders and a thriving family.
story.上生其身、下有出口，木火通明，才思與聲名俱顯，進取順當，是極通達的一局。: Fed from above with an outlet below, Wood and Fire shining together: talent and reputation both shine and progress goes well; a very open road.
story.上來滋養而下有厚土可立，成功與安定兼得，能開局亦能守成，福祿綿長。: Nourished from above, with deep soil to stand on below: success and stability together, able to start and to keep, with blessings that last.
story.上雖相生而根基被金所制，縱得一時之伸展，終受牽掣，境遇多變而心常鬱。: Fed from above, but the foundation is held down by Metal: even a spell of growth is held back in the end; life changes often and the heart is often heavy.
story.上下俱來滋養，才思敏捷、人緣亦厚，成功運佳；唯水多木浮，宜及早扎穩。: Nourished from above and below: quick-minded and well liked, with good Success Luck; but too much Water makes Wood float, so put down roots early.
story.上來相激而下能生我，己身處兩難而尚有可依，成事迂迴，宜借下之力。: Clashed with from above, but below can feed you: caught between the two with something to lean on, success comes the long way round. Lean on help from below.
story.上水下火兩相激盪，己身居其中，境遇急變、災厄頻仍，宜守靜遠禍。: Water above and Fire below churn against each other with you in the middle: sudden changes and frequent troubles. Best to keep still and stay clear of trouble.
story.上剋其身而下能承之，銳氣雖被澆熄，根基尚可守，宜穩步經營、勿求速成。: Restrained from above but held up from below: your drive is doused, but the foundation can still be kept. Work steadily and do not seek quick success.
story.上剋其身、下又被己所熔，前後失據，屢起屢落，須防積勞與破財。: Restrained from above, while below is melted by you: no footing front or back, rising and falling again and again. Beware of overwork and money losses.
story.前後皆水，己火受夾而屢被撲滅，志難得伸，境遇困頓，宜大幅收斂。: Water before and behind, your Fire squeezed and smothered again and again: ambitions cannot stretch and life is hard. Best to rein in hard.
story.己身剋上而下木相侵，兩頭受制，根基崩落之象，縱勤勉亦多勞少得。: You restrain what is above and Wood below encroaches, holding you at both ends: a picture of a crumbling foundation, much toil for little gain even with hard work.
story.剋上而下火生我，根基得暖，境遇可稍安，憑沉穩能換取一時之成。: You restrain what is above, and Fire below feeds you: the foundation is warmed and life can settle a little; steadiness can win success for a time.
story.上被己剋而下有厚土，根基篤實，雖上進遲緩，勝在守得住，安分則無咎。: You restrain what is above, with deep soil below: a solid foundation; progress is slow, but what you have, you keep, and contentment brings no harm.
story.剋上而土能生金，根基有出口，成事費力卻終有所得，宜借外力不宜獨扛。: You restrain what is above, and Earth feeds Metal, so the foundation has an outlet: success takes effort but brings something in the end. Best to take help rather than carry it all alone.
story.上下皆水而己土居中相堵，四面受衝，根基崩落，境遇動盪，須防大變。: Water above and below, with your Earth in the middle damming it: battered on all sides, the foundation crumbles and life is unsettled; watch out for big changes.
story.上得己生而下與己相扞，銳氣有源卻無處安放，與下不合，成事而不得人和。: You feed what is above, but below clashes with you: your drive has a source but nowhere to go; at odds with those below you, you succeed without harmony.
story.上得己生而下來熔己，得而復失之象，屢成屢敗，宜穩守勿貪。: You feed what is above, but below melts you: a picture of gaining and losing again, success and failure in turn. Hold steady and do not be greedy.
story.厚土生金、金又生上，一路順行，助力充沛而根基穩固，名利可期。: Deep Earth feeds Metal and Metal feeds what is above, flowing in order: plenty of help and a firm foundation; fame and fortune in prospect.
story.上得己生而己身堅剛，能排萬難以成事；唯乏同化之力，宜養涵容之量。: You feed what is above, and you are hard and firm: able to clear every obstacle and succeed; but slow to blend in, so cultivate tolerance.
story.前後皆水而己金能生之，才思敏捷、氣能外達，境遇安泰，人緣亦厚。: Water before and behind, fed by your Metal: a quick mind, energy that reaches outward, a calm life and many friends.
story.上下同流而下有出口，氣盛而能落到實處，成功順遂，晚景亦豐。: Flowing together above and below, with an outlet beneath: strong energy that can land; success goes smoothly, and later years are rich.
story.上下俱水而下火受澆，銳氣難存，境遇急變，成而復敗，宜守靜。: Water above and below, and the Fire beneath is doused: drive is hard to keep, with sudden changes and success followed by failure. Best to keep still.
story.上下同流而下有所堵，氣盛卻壅塞不通，志向難伸，宜迂迴圖之。: Flowing together above and below but blocked beneath: strong energy that is choked, and ambitions that cannot stretch. Go the long way round.

story.三水相聚，才思與聲勢俱盛，能取名利；唯流動無著，勝敗都極端，宜擇一處扎穩。: Three Waters together: talent and momentum are both strong and can win fame and fortune; but flowing with nowhere to land, wins and losses are extreme. Best to put down roots in one place.
story.與長上同氣，上進不疾而穩，大體無阻，可望安順。: Of one energy with your elders: progress is steady rather than fast, mostly unobstructed, and things can go smoothly.
story.上得時勢之便，志向能往外伸展，進取順遂。: The times are on your side above: ambitions can reach outward and progress goes well.
story.上壓於下，志難得伸，縱有才亦須久候其時。: Pressed down from above: ambitions are hard to stretch, and even with talent you must wait long for your time.
story.受上壓制，屢逢阻撓，成事費力，宜守待時而非硬爭。: Held down from above and blocked again and again: success takes effort. Hold on and wait for your time rather than force it.
story.得上滋養，長上肯提攜，上進雖不迅疾而少受阻。: Nourished from above, with elders willing to help: progress is not fast but meets little resistance.
story.長上如薪相助，志向易得伸展，是上進最順的一檔。: Elders help like firewood on a fire, and ambitions stretch easily: the smoothest kind of progress.
story.與長上同氣，志同道合，進取順當，唯須防同熱相爭。: Of one energy with your elders, sharing the same goals: progress goes well, but beware of rivalry between two of a kind.
story.能把志向落成實事，長上大體不阻，穩步可成。: You can turn ambitions into real things, and elders mostly do not stand in the way: steady steps succeed.
story.上下相扞，志高而屢受挫抑，成事而不得人和。: Above and below clash: high ambitions are often held back, and success comes without harmony.
story.上來相制，銳氣屢遭澆熄，宜轉柔緩圖而非硬頂。: Held in check from above, your edge doused again and again: soften and take your time rather than push head-on.
story.受上侵擾，上進多阻，縱勤勉亦見遲成。: Harassed from above: progress meets many obstacles, and even hard work brings late success.
story.長上如日相照，得提攜與時勢之助，志多能達。: Elders shine on you like the sun: with their help and the times on your side, most ambitions are reached.
story.淳厚鈍重，易親亦易離，上進雖遲，大體無憂。: Sincere, steady and slow: quick to make friends and to lose them; progress is slow, but mostly free of worry.
story.上得其位、下得其用，志向順遂，名利可期。: Those above in their place and those below of use: ambitions go well, with fame and fortune in prospect.
story.上下不相謀，志向難得回應，宜自立而非仰賴。: Above and below go their own ways, and ambitions find little response: stand on your own rather than rely on others.
story.力見勢屈，身心過勞，易生不平事端；若肯埋頭邁進，先難後易亦能成。: Strength shown but pushed back: overwork in body and mind, and grievances come easily; yet if you put your head down and press on, hard at first and easier later, you can succeed.
story.上來相剋，銳氣受挫，成事須多繞一程，宜養耐性。: Restrained from above, your edge is checked: success takes a detour, so cultivate patience.
story.厚土生金，長上惠助，排難而順遂，是上進最順的一檔。: Deep Earth feeds Metal and elders help: obstacles clear and things go smoothly; the smoothest kind of progress.
story.上下皆剛，互不相下，志高而多衝突，成事而傷和氣。: Hard above and below, neither giving way: high ambitions with many clashes, and success that costs goodwill.
story.氣能外達，長上不阻，上進雖須自己使力，終可得成。: Your energy reaches outward and elders do not stand in the way: progress needs your own effort, but success comes in the end.
story.上下相榮，長上樂於成全，志向舒展，進取順遂。: Above and below flourish together and elders are glad to help: ambitions unfold and progress goes well.
story.上來相激，進退失據，志難安定，宜擇一而守。: Clashes from above: no footing forward or back, and ambitions are hard to settle. Choose one and hold to it.
story.上有所拘而志仍可伸，倍受抑壓、勞而少功，然盡瘁努力可否極泰來。: Constrained from above, yet ambitions can still stretch; much pressure and effort for little reward, but with full commitment bad times turn to good.
story.上得金生，長上提攜有力，上進順調，志多能達。: Fed by Metal from above, with strong help from elders: progress goes smoothly and most ambitions are reached.
story.上下俱流，無所依止，一時之盛難久，終成飄蕩。: Both above and below flow, with nothing to hold on to: a spell of success is hard to keep, and in the end you drift.
story.根基同氣，穩當不折騰，雖少爆發之機，勝在少變動、少內耗。: A foundation of one energy: steady and settled, with few bursts of luck but few changes and little strain.
story.根基順勢向上，精力能往外使，住所與身體大體安穩。: A foundation that rises with the flow: your energy goes outward, and home and health are mostly secure.
story.立木於厚土，根基極穩，境遇安定長久，下屬與晚輩也得力。: A tree in deep soil: a very firm foundation, a stable life for a long time, with capable people below you.
story.根基被壓，屢有變動，住所工作難安，須防肝膽與神經耗損。: A foundation pressed down, with frequent changes: home and work are hard to settle; take care of liver, gall bladder and nerves.
story.看似受滋養，實則根浮不實，境遇多遷移，安定難久。: It looks well watered, but the roots float: many moves, and stability is hard to keep.
story.根基有薪可續，境遇穩步向好，得下屬之助，身心少受折損。: A foundation with firewood to keep it going: life steadily improves, with help from those below you and little wear on body and mind.
story.同氣相聚，一時旺盛，然易過耗，宜留餘力而非一味燃燒。: Like energy gathered together: strong for a while but easily overspent, so keep some strength in reserve rather than burn on.
story.火生土厚，根基踏實，雖升得不快，安穩可長保。: Fire feeds deep Earth: a down-to-earth foundation; you rise slowly, but security lasts.
story.根基受制，用力而少得，住所多變，須防心血與呼吸之疾。: A foundation held in check: effort with little gain and frequent moves; take care of heart, blood and breathing.
story.水火相激，根基不安，境遇屢變，易生急禍與身心兩耗。: Water and Fire clash: an unsettled foundation, frequent changes, sudden trouble and strain on body and mind.
story.根基被侵，安定難求，住所與工作常遷，須防脾胃受損。: A foundation encroached on: stability is hard to find and home and work often change; take care of the stomach.
story.得下之扶持，境遇安固可期，另有意外之助，是最穩的一檔。: Support from below: a secure life can be expected, with unexpected help too; the steadiest kind of foundation.
story.厚土相疊，根基篤實，進退有據，雖少奇遇而少傾覆。: Deep Earth stacked: a solid foundation and sure footing, with few surprises and few collapses.
story.土能生金，根基有出口，下屬得力，付出能見回報。: Earth feeds Metal, so the foundation has an outlet: capable people below you, and effort that pays off.
story.土散水流，根基崩落之象，境遇動盪，須防大變與身弱。: Earth scattering and Water flowing away, a picture of a crumbling foundation: life is unsettled; watch for big changes and frailty.
story.根基相扞格，事事需自己壓著走，久之身心俱疲。: A foundation at odds with itself: everything has to be pushed along by you, and in time body and mind tire.
story.根基受鍛而不受托，壓力常在，住所與健康皆宜留意。: A foundation that is tempered rather than supported: pressure is constant, and home and health both need care.
story.厚土生金，根基安固，身心安定，四顧順調，是最穩的一檔。: Deep Earth feeds Metal: a secure foundation, body and mind at ease, everything around going smoothly; the steadiest kind.
story.過於堅剛，乏同化之力，與下不合、與人易離，反成孤立。: Too hard and rigid, slow to blend in: at odds with those below you and quick to part from others, ending up isolated.
story.金氣外洩於水，雖得一時之勢，恐成流蕩漂零，安定難求。: Metal’s energy drains into Water: a surge for a while, but you may end up drifting, with stability hard to find.
story.水木相榮，根基漸次舒展，境遇向好，得晚輩與下屬之力。: Water and Wood flourish together: the foundation gradually unfolds and life improves, with help from the young and those below you.
story.水火相沖，根基屢受急變，災厄疊來，安寧難得。: Water and Fire clash: the foundation is hit by sudden changes, troubles pile up, and peace is hard to find.
story.土來堵水，根基受阻，進退兩難，住所與工作難安。: Earth dams the Water: the foundation is blocked, stuck between forward and back, with home and work hard to settle.
story.金水相生而根基受托，境遇安定，下屬得力，身心亦少損耗。: Metal and Water feed each other and the foundation is held up: a stable life, capable people below you, and little wear on body and mind.
story.同為流動之象，一時可發大勢，久則漂零無著，孤獨易生。: Both flowing: a surge for a while, but in time you drift with nowhere to land, and loneliness comes easily.
story.與人同氣，相處平和，圈子穩定，不惹是非。: Of one energy with others: peaceful company, a steady circle, and no trouble.
story.待人熱絡而付出多，人緣不差，唯易因過熱生耗。: Warm to others and giving much: well liked, but too much warmth can wear you out.
story.能在群體中立得住，外緣穩，遇事有人願幫。: You can hold your own in a group: steady connections, and people willing to help when needed.
story.外有磨礪卻不失體面，人際雖偶有摩擦，大體可用。: Some friction from outside, but your dignity is kept: the occasional rub, but on the whole relationships work.
story.外緣溫潤，人多相助，人際是助力而非消耗。: Warm, easy connections and many helpers: people are a help, not a drain.
story.外有可依而付出亦多，人緣尚可，唯易生不平之感。: Something to lean on outside, but you give a lot: fairly well liked, though it can feel unfair.
story.同熱相聚，熱鬧一時，久則相爭，反成消耗。: Two fires together: lively for a while, but in time rivalry turns it into a drain.
story.能把熱情落成實處，待人厚道，外緣安穩可靠。: Your warmth turns into something real: kind to others, with steady, reliable connections.
story.外來磨折不少，人際多摩擦，宜少涉是非。: Plenty of trials from outside and friction with people: best to stay out of disputes.
story.外境屢澆其銳，人際常成負擔，宜慎擇交往。: The world douses your edge again and again, and people often become a burden: choose your company carefully.
story.外有侵擾而尚能自守，人際須多費心，回報有限。: Harassed from outside but able to hold your own: relationships take extra care, for limited return.
story.得外之溫助，人緣和順，遇事有人相幫。: Warmed and helped from outside: easy, harmonious relationships, with people to help when needed.
story.厚重同氣，與人相處平實，圈子穩定少變。: Solid and of one kind: plain, honest company and a steady circle that changes little.
story.外有出口，待人誠實，人際能轉成實際的助力。: An outlet outside: honest with others, and relationships turn into real help.
story.外境流散難聚，人際浮泛，交往宜擇而非廣。: The world around is scattered and hard to gather: ties are shallow, so choose friends rather than collect them.
story.外與己相扞，人際多不順，易受排擠與掣肘。: The world clashes with you: relationships often go wrong, and you may be pushed aside or held back.
story.外來相剋，人際常成負擔，言語宜收斂。: Restrained from outside: people often become a burden, so mind your words.
story.外得厚土之助，人緣安穩，遇事有人相幫，交往少損耗。: Helped by deep Earth from outside: steady friendships, help when needed, and little lost in dealing with people.
story.兩剛相遇，誰也不讓，交往易生衝突而難同化。: Two hard forces meet and neither gives way: dealings easily turn into clashes, and it is hard to blend in.
story.對外好交遊、內實空虛，好誇口而少落實，終易失人。: Sociable outside but hollow inside, quick to boast and slow to deliver: in the end it is easy to lose people.
story.外緣舒展，人多相親，人際是助力而非消耗。: Open, easy connections and many who feel close: people are a help, not a drain.
story.外有可為而須自持，人際尚順，唯宜防急躁傷人。: There is much you can do outside, but keep yourself in check: relationships go fairly well, but beware of impatience hurting others.
story.外有所依，交往踏實，圈子雖不大而可靠。: Something to rely on outside: solid friendships, and a small but reliable circle.
story.外得金生，人緣佳，遇事有人願出力。: Fed by Metal from outside: well liked, with people willing to pitch in.
story.同流相聚，來往輕快，人緣不差，唯宜防交淺言深。: Flowing together: easy, lively company and fairly well liked, but beware of opening up too soon to people you hardly know.
